sources.articleTitle: Messi’s Inter Miami crash out of MLS Cup playoffs

headline: Columbus Crew Defeats Inter Miami To Advance In MLS Cup Playoffs
metaDescription: Columbus Crew eliminated Inter Miami from the MLS Cup playoffs following a late game-winning goal, successfully sweeping the first-round series 2-0.
aiSummaryBullets: Columbus Crew secured a 1-0 victory over Inter Miami in their latest playoff match.
A decisive goal from Santiago Rodriguez during injury time determined the outcome of the game.
The win allows Columbus Crew to complete a 2-0 series sweep and advance in the MLS Cup playoffs.
aiContextParagraph: The MLS Cup playoffs represent the postseason tournament for Major League Soccer, where teams compete in a series format to determine the league champion. In the recent first-round matchup, Inter Miami faced the Columbus Crew. Following a closely contested series, the Columbus Crew managed to secure a 1-0 victory in the most recent meeting, thanks to a goal scored by Santiago Rodriguez in injury time. This win provided the Columbus Crew with a 2-0 sweep over Inter Miami, effectively ending the postseason campaign for the latter. The result marks a significant shift in the playoff bracket as teams continue their quest for the MLS Cup title. The outcome has drawn attention due to the high profile of the participating clubs and the competitive nature of the series which concluded with a dramatic final goal.
